summary: 道武帝长子，父被弑后平乱即位；乘刘裕灭后秦之机取河南，尽有司兖豫淮北之地；立太子监国制，泰常八年崩。
summary_en: Eldest son of Daowu, he put down the rebellion after his father's slaying and took the throne; riding Liu Yu's conquest of Later Qin, he took Henan and held Si, Yan, Yu, and the Huai north; he established the heir's regency and died in the 8th year of Taichang.

portrait.appearance_basis: 史载无形貌描写。画像宜表现守成拓疆的君主之态，衣冠从北魏初制。属艺术想象。

timeline.title: 即位
timeline.summary: 平清河王绍乱，即位改元永兴。
timeline.summary_en: He put down the Prince of Qinghe's rising, took the throne, and changed the era to Yongxing.

timeline.title: 刘裕北伐关中
timeline.summary: 裕灭后秦，魏伺机争河南。
timeline.summary_en: As Yu destroyed Later Qin, Wei watched for its chance at Henan.

timeline.title: 取河南
timeline.summary: 遣军取滑台、虎牢等，尽有司兖豫淮北。
timeline.summary_en: His armies took Huatai, Hulao, and the rest — Si, Yan, Yu, and the Huai north were his.

timeline.title: 明元帝崩
timeline.summary: 崩，太子焘继，是为太武帝。
timeline.summary_en: He died; his heir Tao succeeded — Emperor Taiwu.

timeline.title: 太子监国
timeline.summary: 立焘为太子监国，为北魏储制重要。
timeline.summary_en: He made Tao heir and regent — an important step in Northern Wei's succession system.

bio_md:
# 明元帝 · 主要事迹

拓跋嗣，道武帝长子。天赐六年，清河王绍弑道武，嗣在外闻变，入平城平乱，诛绍，即皇帝位，改元永兴。明元帝承道武之业，守成拓疆：泰常元年，刘裕北伐后秦，魏军乘机取滑台、虎牢等地；泰常七年，尽有司、兖、豫诸州及淮北之地——南朝疆域自此以淮水为界，南北对峙之局遂定。

明元帝之政，重在稳定：立太子焘为太子监国，「太子监国」之制，为北魏储君制度之始；又减赋税、抚流民，与民休息。然其体弱，泰常八年崩，年三十二，太子焘即位，是为太武帝。

史评明元帝：「明睿宽和，允文允武。」以守成之君而当刘裕北伐之际，能乘乱拓土、坐收渔利，其识见不在道武之下。明元之世，北魏「国富民强」；太武帝之统一北方，实赖其父所积之基。

> 参考：点校本《魏书》卷003《太宗纪》。

bio_parts_en.value:
Tuoba Si was the eldest son of Emperor Daowu. In the 6th year of Tianci the Prince of Qinghe slew Daowu; Si, hearing the news abroad, entered Pingcheng, put down the rebellion, slew Shao, and took the throne, changing the era to Yongxing. He carried on Daowu's work, holding the realm and extending it: in the 1st year of Taichang, as Liu Yu campaigned against Later Qin, the Wei armies took Huatai, Hulao, and the rest; in the 7th year he held Si, Yan, Yu, and the lands north of the Huai — the southern frontier ran along the Huai from that day, and the standoff of north and south was fixed.

His government aimed at stability: he made his heir Tao regent — the "heir's regency" that began Northern Wei's succession system — and lightened the levies and comforted the refugees. But his health failed; he died in the 8th year of Taichang at thirty-two, and his heir Tao succeeded as Emperor Taiwu.

The histories say of him: "sharp, gentle, of both letters and arms." A steward who, in the moment of Liu Yu's great expedition, extended his borders and reaped where others sowed — his vision matched Daowu's own. His reign made the state rich and strong; the unification of the north under Taiwu stood on the foundations his father and he had laid.

> References: the punctuated critical edition of the *Weishu*, ch. 3 ("Benji of Emperor Mingyuan").
